device_boundary.target_input: XVF3800 input :0, two fused CoreAudio channels

frozen_physical_geometry.speaker_arrangement: small left and right speakers stacked vertically with both acoustic centers on the board's 180 degree radial axis
frozen_physical_geometry.speaker_aim: both speakers facing the XVF3800 microphone array center
frozen_physical_geometry.distance_reference: speaker grilles to XVF3800 board center

operator_authorization.scope: one fixed 12-trial protocol run only, capped at 75.6 seconds total playback, with no automatic retry

failure_policy: Any failed gate is retained. No threshold, seed, grammar, token, or feature change may reuse the captured held-out trials as confirmation.
claim_boundary: A pass supports locally learned next-state prediction for two controlled acoustic families after one named playback/capture geometry. It does not support unconstrained or semantic speech prediction and does not complete H2 by itself.
